svg.text: MisterPlex: system block diagram (rc5 · PlexOB core)
Plex, AirPlay and YouTube casting on MiSTer DE10-Nano · ARM daemon feeds the PlexOB H.264 core through shared DDR3 (no SDRAM board) · Cyclone V 5CSEBA6 · 41,033 / 41,910 ALMs (97.9%)
misterplexd · cast + playback daemon (one static ARM binary)
play queue → Plex resolve → PMS stream
AirPlay works on the MiSTer by itself;
a helper on a computer is optional
audio: RAOP + spectrum screen · no mirroring
DIAL + SSDP answered only while Lounge is up
new play stops old · Stop always stops
pad / keyboard from the core input region
opaque library page over idle bars
build ID read from ring word 88
only the shipped PlexOB build plays;
RTC, then SNTP, then HTTPS Date
returns home · not yet checked on a TV
maps ring control page + 8 MiB ring
never maps the core's idle FB
1. load PlexOB if another core runs
2. wait ≤ 60 s for network, then start
shown by the core's overlay plane
HPS DDR3 (shared with Linux) · FPGA side via f2sdram bridges
Ring control block: core status 0–31 · program 32–39 (write index,
pause / volume, settings, rumble) · status 40–47 · input 48–71
overlay descriptor 72–79 · telemetry 80–87 (87 = Y/C) · build ID 88–95
Record ring: H.264 access units + 48 kHz s16 PCM audio records
DPB: 20 picture stores (decoder writes, display reads)
core rewrites the status block every frame;
FPGA fabric · Cyclone V 5CSEBA6 · PlexOB core (fork of owenb's H.264 decoder)
Timing (worst of four corners): all clocks ≥ 0 ns except pll_hdmi setup −0.166 ns (bar −0.3 ns)
worst hold +0.092 ns · all fit gates PASS
ram1 + ram2 into HPS DDR3 · clk_mem 90 MHz
reads AU + audio records on ram1
the daemon reads them for the menus
word 87: Y/C mode · word 88: build ID
colour bars when no stream plays
planned: not yet tested on a screen
Logic: 41,033 / 41,910 ALMs (97.9%) · input mirror (ring_in) kept in the netlist: 601 ALUTs / 1,026 registers
Setup slack: pll_hdmi −0.166 ns (bar −0.3 ns, TNS −2.403) · worst other clock +0.197 ns · hold ≥ +0.092 ns
Gates: timing gate, hdmi_pll_check, fmax_check, lint_undriven, netlist_canary all PASS
clk_dec 96.43 MHz: H.264 decoder · Fmax 104.87 / 104.62 MHz (100 °C / −40 °C) vs 101.4 MHz check
clk_mem 90 MHz: DDR3 ports (ram1, ram2) and DDR-side engines
clk_sys 27 MHz: HPS interface, display control, audio tick
clk_vid 81 MHz raster · Fmax 91.6 / 89.4 MHz vs 86.0 MHz check · pll_hdmi (scaler)
two colours = block spans both clock domains
network media: HLS / https video + audio
planned / not yet proven on glass
Source: MisterPlex rc5 tree (daemon, boot hook, PlexOB RTL) · fit + timing: Quartus reports of the shipped PlexOB core, seed 10 · see VERIFY.md
